_note: Optional. GMGN OpenAPI is the fee source for the minTokenFeesSol gate (more accurate than Jupiter's `fees`) and the Evil Panda anti-rug source (stat.top_rat_trader_percentage, stat.top_bundler_trader_percentage, dev.cto_flag on GET /v1/token/info). Copy to gmgn-config.json and fill apiKey, or set GMGN_API_KEY in .env. Fee lookup falls back to Jupiter when the key or call is missing. Evil Panda anti-rug does not: a missing key, payload, or failed call skips the token. Set feeSource to "jupiter" to disable the fee lookup only.
